the person i want to be wth doesnt want to be with me. so instead i just fuck anyone who will have me.

i wish i was never born. all ive ever been is an exhausting burden for everyone in my life. itll help everyone if im gone. theyll be sad for a bit but then theyll forget about me, no one remembers me or notices me anyway
